title: Security Readiness Calendar and Gate Criteria for SOC2/ISO/SSO Rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Create a single canonical readiness calendar and explicit gate criteria that product, security, and engineering teams can use to track progress toward SOC2 Type II readiness, ISO27001 intake, and SSO/SAML + audit-logging deliverables.

Scope:
- Define milestone cadence across three workstreams: Controls & Policy, Platform Controls (SSO/SAML, audit logs), and Evidence & Ops (playbooks, evidence collection).
- Produce a calendar with incremental gates (Alpha, Beta, Readiness Review, Pre-Audit, Audit) mapped to cycles and owners.
- Specify pass/fail criteria for each gate (artifacts required, test coverage, incidents mitigated).
- Integrate milestone status with OKRs and the roadmap tracker so execs can view readiness by region and deployment mode (Hosted, Dedicated, Private).

Deliverables:
1) Readiness calendar (CSV + calendar feed) with per-cycle targets and owners.
2) Gate checklist templates for each milestone (document links, evidence owners, verification steps).
3) Roadmap view in Console roadmap doc (Confluence) and a summary widget for executive weekly digest.
4) Risk log and mitigation playbook for blockers that can delay audit windows.

Gate examples (high level):
- Alpha (cycle level) — Security design review completed, SSO prototype integrated in staging, audit-logging enabled for core APIs; required artifacts: design review notes, SSO integration PR, logging config.
- Beta — Automated tests for SSO flows, log retention configured, evidence collection script present; required artifacts: e2e test results, retention policy doc, evidence-gathering runbook.
- Readiness Review — Control owners attestments collected, drift checks run, remediation backlog <= 15 items (no P0 control failures); artifacts: attestation forms, remediation board link.
- Pre-Audit — External readiness assessment scheduled, all critical remediation closed; artifacts: assessment report, incident postmortems.

Acceptance criteria:
- All gates have explicit owners and a single linked artifact per required item (Confluence/Drive/GitHub).
- Calendar integrates with Linear cycles and marks dependencies automatically for ENG tickets listed as blockers.
- Executive summary exposes progress and pulls the top 3 risks per workstream.

Trade-offs & notes:
- We prioritize evidence completeness over full feature parity for Dedicated/Private on the first audit run; region-specific controls (e.g., EU data residency) will be staged into later gates.
- Short-term manual attestation allowed for non-customer-impacting controls to avoid blocking audit date.

People & owners:
- PM owner: Luca Moreno (assignee) — overall milestone coordinator.
- Eng lead: Claire Zhang (ENG-2339) — platform controls (SSO, audit logs).
- Security lead: Omar Ruiz — controls & policy validation.
- Compliance ops: Maya Thompson — evidence orchestration and auditor liaison.

Links & artifacts:
- Draft readiness calendar (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleCalendarDraft
- Gate checklist templates (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/TRUST/Gate+Checklists
- SSO design RFC: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/78
- Audit log schema PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/412

Risks:
- Delay in ENG-2114 (KV cache logging) will block automated evidence collection for tokenized requests.
- Third-party IdP compatibility tests may reveal integration regressions requiring design changes.

Next steps (this cycle):
- Finalize gate checklist templates and publish to Confluence (owner: Aisha Patel) — target 2025-03-14.
- Run a dry-readiness review for Beta gate with internal auditors (owner: Maya Thompson) — target 2025-03-28.
- Create the Calendar CSV and a public calendar feed for execs (owner: Luca Moreno) — target 2025-04-02.
